title: Multimodal Information Fusion for Chart Understanding: A Survey of MLLMs -- Evolution, Limitations, and Cognitive Enhancement
abstract: arXiv:2602.10138v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Chart understanding is a quintessential information fusion task, requiring the seamless integration of graphical and textual data to extract meaning. The advent of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has revolutionized this domain, yet the landscape of MLLM-based chart analysis remains fragmented and lacks systematic organization. This survey provides a comprehensive roadmap of this nascent frontier by structuring the domain's core components. We begin by analyzing the fundamental challenges of fusing visual and linguistic information in charts. We then categorize downstream tasks and datasets, introducing a novel taxonomy of canonical and non-canonical benchmarks to highlight the field's expanding scope. Subsequently, we present a comprehensive evolution of methodologies, tracing the progression from classic deep learning techniques to state-of-the-art MLLM paradigms that leverage sophisticated fusion strategies. translated_title: 面向图表理解的多模态信息融合：多模态大语言模型（MLLM）综述——演进、局限性与认知增强
translated_abstract: 图表理解是一项典型的信息融合任务，需要将图形数据与文本数据无缝整合以提取含义。多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的出现彻底变革了这一领域，然而基于MLLM的图表分析研究现状仍较为碎片化，缺乏系统性梳理。本综述通过构建该领域核心组件的结构化框架，为这一新兴前沿提供了全面的路线图。我们首先分析了图表中视觉与语言信息融合所面临的基本挑战。随后，我们对下游任务和数据集进行了分类，并引入了一种新颖的规范型与非规范型基准分类法，以凸显该领域不断扩展的研究范围。接着，我们全面梳理了方法论的演进历程，从经典深度学习技术追溯到采用复杂融合策略的最先进MLLM范式。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的图表理解研究，分析了视觉与语言信息融合的核心挑战，提出了规范型与非规范型基准的新颖分类体系，并追溯了从经典深度学习技术到先进MLLM融合范式的方法演进历程。
